questionText:

(A) Birth of Poetry (1980)

(I) Sage's overwhelming grief transforming instantaneously into the world's first Sanskrit shloka
(II) Three village women sitting intimately together exchanging cheerful rural news in bright light
(III) Hebbar's masterpiece depicting the divine genesis of classical poetic creation through sorrow
